title: What should I check before renting a factory in Puchong?
question: What should I check before renting a factory in Puchong?
answer: Check that the land use and approvals allow your type of operation, that the power supply, ceiling height, floor and loading access fit your machines and trucks, and that the title, tenancy terms and renovation rules work for you. Doing this before paying a deposit avoids the most common and expensive surprises.

sections.heading: 1. Zoning and approvals
body: Make sure the property is on industrial land and that your activity fits what is allowed there. Light assembly, storage and food processing can have very different requirements.

Ask whether the building has its certificate of completion and compliance (CCC) or certificate of fitness, and check with the local council what you need for your business licence. Most of Puchong falls under Majlis Bandaraya Subang Jaya (MBSJ).

sections.heading: 2. Power, height and floor
body: List your machines and their electricity needs, then compare them with the unit's existing supply. Upgrading power supply can take time and money.
Check the clear ceiling height if you use racking or overhead cranes, and the floor loading if you have heavy equipment.

sections.heading: 3. Access and loading
body: Confirm that the trucks or containers you use can enter the road, turn and load. Detached and semi-detached factories usually have more compound space than terrace factories.
Look at the distance to the highways you depend on and at traffic during working hours.

sections.heading: 4. Title and tenancy terms
body: Note whether the property is freehold or leasehold and individual or strata title, as this affects approvals and how long the owner can commit.
Agree in writing on the rental period, renewal option, deposits, who pays for repairs and maintenance, and whether service tax applies to the rent.

sections.heading: 5. Renovation and fire safety
body: Ask the owner what renovations are allowed and whether they need council or fire department approval. Budget for any fire safety upgrades your operation needs.

faqs.q: Which is better to rent: a terrace, semi-detached or detached factory?
faqs.a: Terrace factories are usually the most affordable. Semi-detached and detached factories cost more but offer more compound space, better loading and room to expand. Choose based on your trucks, power needs and growth plans.

faqs.q: Which council handles business licences in Puchong?
faqs.a: Most of Puchong, including the town centre, is under Majlis Bandaraya Subang Jaya (MBSJ). Some parts fall under Kuala Lumpur City Hall (DBKL), Majlis Perbandaran Sepang or Majlis Perbandaran Kuala Langat, so check the exact address before applying.
